fields.lblAnnualInfoStateSpecific: The most a Member must pay for Covered Services in a Plan year. After a Member spends this amount on deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance, Molina pays 100% of the cost of Coverage Services.
fields.lblEstmtrDescription: You can use Molina's Cost Estimator Tool to estimate how much you may owe for a covered item or service. Click the Cost Estimator button to launch the tool. Use your Molina Member Portal Username and Password to log in.
